title: Mathematics Galaxy v0.1 Research Preview
boundaries: H, D and R values are project-curated research assumptions rather than objective measurements or independent expert consensus.
The 30-node Lean-derived experiment supplies candidate evidence for only part of this release and does not replace curated release relations.
Missing R values are unassessed rather than proven unrelated.
Coordinates are a deterministic diagnostic projection and do not create knowledge facts.
Independent mathematical expert review and real-browser visual acceptance remain pending.
